invariants.rationale: The method expects dedupedRecords to be a valid input list.
A context is required to perform tagging operations.
A table reference is needed to call getIndex and tagLocation.
This is implied by the definition of List; all lists are either empty or not, so it's justifiable, but not deep.
table.getIndex() is called in the method body; must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
